# TSLA — Catalysts

## TL;DR

Q1 2026 earnings (April 22) resolved — EPS $0.41 beat ($0.33 estimate), gross margin 18.03% (crossed 18%+ flip threshold), revenue slight miss. Active positive catalysts: Tesla Semi mass production in Nevada, FSD Netherlands regulatory approval seeking EU-wide rollout, Terafab semiconductor foundry with Intel, unsupervised robotaxi rides now operating in Austin, Dallas, and Houston, FSD subscriptions at 1.28M (+51% YoY). Governance negatives deepened: $573M related-party transactions and $2B xAI-to-SpaceX equity swap. Kevin Warsh Fed Chair confirmation vote (May 15, ~7 trading days as of May 6) remains the dominant near-term macro headwind for high-beta growth names. Analyst consensus avg PT $405.47. [source: runs/20260506_160353/web_research/TSLA.json]

## Positive catalysts (active)

**Q1 2026 earnings beat — margin threshold crossed**
EPS $0.41 vs $0.33 estimate; gross margin 18.03% (crossed the 18%+ flip threshold). Revenue slight miss. Services revenue +42% YoY; FSD subscriptions 1.28M (+51% YoY). Q1 deliveries reclaimed global pure-BEV sales lead from BYD (358,023 vs BYD 310K). [source: web_research/TSLA.json — CNBC Apr 22 2026]

**Tesla Semi enters mass production in Nevada**
Customer deliveries beginning — first mass-produced electric Class 8 semi. Near-term volume and services revenue impact limited but validates commercial vehicle platform. [source: web_research/TSLA.json — Simply Wall St, May 2026]

**FSD Netherlands approval + EU-wide rollout bid**
Dutch regulator RDW seeking EU-wide FSD approval — a regulatory flywheel that could unlock the full European installed base for supervised FSD revenue. Spring 2026 OTA includes Grok integration. [source: web_research/TSLA.json — Simply Wall St, May 2026]

**Terafab chip foundry project (with Intel) advancing**
$25B+ semiconductor foundry project — reduces TSLA dependence on third-party chips for FSD and Dojo hardware. Multi-year structural positive; no near-term P&L impact. [source: web_research/TSLA.json — 24/7 Wall St, May 3 2026]

**Unsupervised robotaxi — commercial rides in Austin, Dallas, Houston**
Commercial rides active in Austin (modified Model Y). Robotaxi rides also launched in Dallas and Houston per run 20260506_160353. Cybercab rolling off Giga Texas since February 2026. [source: web_research/TSLA.json — 24/7 Wall St, Yahoo Finance, May 2026]

## Negative catalysts (active)

**Governance concerns deepening**
Amended 10-K: $573M in 2025 related-party transactions (SpaceX, xAI, Boring Co, X). Tesla invested $2B in xAI Holdings Series E; stake converted to SpaceX Class A shares after SpaceX-xAI merger. Raises capital allocation and conflict-of-interest risk. [source: web_research/TSLA.json — Yahoo Finance / Electrek, May 2026]

**$25B capex plan — negative FCF for 2026**
Three times the $8.5B in 2025. Targets: Cybercab, robotaxi network, Optimus, AI infrastructure, Terafab. Negative FCF means no buyback support; dilution risk rises. [source: runs/20260501_160246/web_research/TSLA.json]

**Worst delivery-production gap on record**
Q1 2026: 358,023 delivered vs. 408,386 produced — 50,363 unsold vehicles. JPMorgan $145 Underweight target outstanding. [source: bootstrap + runs/20260501_160246/web_research/TSLA.json]

## Upcoming catalyst schedule

| Date | Event | Directional bias |
|---|---|---|
| May 15, 2026 | Kevin Warsh Fed Chair confirmation vote | Macro headwind — hawkish successor = growth stock pressure |
| ~July 22, 2026 | Q2 2026 earnings (consensus EPS ~$0.42) | Binary |
| Ongoing | Cybercab volume ramp progress | Positive if >10k/month by Q3 |
| Ongoing | FSD Europe rollout (EU-wide RDW bid) | Positive |

## Analyst consensus

~26-31 analysts: ~10 Buy / 8 Hold / 7 Sell. Average PT $405.47. Wedbush (Dan Ives) bull at $600 Outperform; Piper Sandler $500 Outperform; Seeking Alpha downgraded to Hold. JPMorgan $145 Underweight. UBS raised to $352 on April 14, 2026. Wide range: $25.53 bear case to $630 bull case — deep disagreement on autonomous driving and robotics monetization timelines. [source: web_research/TSLA.json — runs/20260506_160353]

## Last updated

2026-05-06. Sourced from runs/20260506_160353/web_research/TSLA.json (dated 2026-05-06). Supersedes prior entry (2026-05-05, run 20260505_160654) — adds Dallas/Houston robotaxi commercial rides; Rivian/Uber partnership and delivery-production gap remain active bear risks; Warsh vote remains primary near-term macro headwind.

## Format

Each lesson is one dated bullet:

`[DATE] | [TICKER] | [SETUP TYPE] | [OUTCOME: +$X / -$X] | [WHY it worked or failed in 1 sentence]`

The "why" should reference: the thesis at the time, the macro regime, which swing strategy recommended it.

---

## Patterns (auto-generated by Sunday compactor, last 30 days)

| Setup Type | Trades | Wins | Win Rate | Avg P&L | Total P&L |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## Lessons

2026-04-30 | NVDA | EMA pullback Fib dip-buy | -$63.20 (corrected from -$264.65) | Stop triggered at $205.30 (hourly Fib 61.8%); swing_trend_momentum and swing_breakout were bullish on AI capex thesis, but price breached the stop zone intraday amid stretched macro (RSI 81–87) with no bullish confirmation candle before exit. **Note:** trade was originally sized 67 shares ($14,020) due to a phantom $100K budget bug (fixed commit b2b472d). With the correct $25K budget at 14.2% vol-adj limit, position would have been 16 shares ($3,348). Corrected P&L reflects the strategy's actual signal quality, not the sizing error.
2026-05-04 | AMZN | mean-reversion fade short | OUTCOME: -$10.14 | Mean-reversion short thesis (April 30 shooting star, RSI 82–88) stopped at $276 as extreme ADX 65 trend absorbed the reversal; swing_mean_reversion recommended the setup but the regime (ADX 60+) sets an elevated bar for fading overbought conditions confirmed by identical NVDA stop-out April 30.
2026-05-05 | DIS | pre-earnings breakout long | OUTCOME: -$4.99 | Pre-earnings breakout above $103 (4/5 swing agents bullish, swing_breakout and swing_trend_momentum) invalidated by macro reversal (Iran escalation May 4, WTI +$105) that converted the April 30 risk-on tailwind into a risk-off headwind; sub-threshold entry volume (1.23x vs. 1.5x minimum) was an early warning sign.
2026-05-06 | GOOG | mean-reversion fade short | OUTCOME: -$6.50 | Mean-reversion short (RSI-7 90.69, Z-score 2.56) stopped at $389.50 as ADX 74.23 extreme trend absorbed the fade; swing_mean_reversion recommended the setup but the regime repeated the NVDA/AMZN pattern — ADX 60+ environments make fading overbought conditions highly unreliable; strongly risk-on macro (S&P ATH, US-Iran MOU) added upside momentum.
2026-05-06 | AMD | statistical exhaustion short | OUTCOME: -$17.82 | Mean-reversion short (Z-score 2.6, RSI 83, +74% 21d surge) gap-stopped at $372.31 when Q1 2026 earnings blowout (+38% YoY, EPS +43%) gapped AMD +15% overnight; swing_mean_reversion and swing_catalyst_news recommended the fade but earnings binary created a non-linear gap-through-stop outcome; half-sizing to 1 share limited damage to -$17.82 vs -$35.64.
